name: US Treasury Fiscal Data API
provider: US Department of the Treasury, Bureau of the Fiscal Service
rate_limits: None published. Calls worked with no key (tested 2026-10-20).
history_start: Varies; average interest rates on Treasury debt from 2001-01.
what_it_has: US government debt, spending, receipts, average interest rates on Treasury debt and Treasury exchange rates used for reporting.
simple: The US government's own record of how much it owes, spends and pays in interest.
license_terms: Free and without restriction, including commercial use and redistribution (source: https://fiscaldata.treasury.gov/api-documentation/).
quality_notes: Every field comes back as a quoted string, so numbers must be converted. Daily yield curves are easier to get from FRED.

relevance.reason: Useful fiscal background, but FRED covers the yields we need.
